Resolves #21476

`Neo.list.plugin.ItemEditing` renames list and tree items in place. F2 on a focused item, or a double-click, opens a text field over the item's text. Enter or leaving the field writes the record's `displayField`, and the list renders it from the store; Escape leaves the record unchanged; focus returns to the item. The field's own validation vetoes a name: an invalid value keeps the edit open and the record unchanged. A list opts in with `plugins: [{module: ItemEditing}]`.

Evidence: L3 (component spec with real keys and pointers on a list and a tree, in CI; frames of the changed surface) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-4). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/component/list/ItemEditing.spec.mjs` › F2 opens the editor with the text, and a double-click opens the editor |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `ItemEditing.spec.mjs` › Enter writes it, leaving the field writes it, Escape leaves the record unchanged |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `ItemEditing.spec.mjs` › an invalid name keeps the old text and the editor open; focus is on the item after Enter and after Escape |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `ItemEditing.spec.mjs` › a tree renames a leaf and a folder; a list without the plugin opens no editor |

## Deltas from ticket

- **A plugin, not `list.Base` code.** The prescription named `Neo.list.Base`; `Neo.grid.plugin.CellEditing` is a plugin, and `list.Base` already runs 1,103 lines. `list.Base` and `tree.List` stay unchanged, and a list without the plugin behaves as released (AC-4's last arm).
- **The veto is the field's validation**, configured through the plugin's `editor` (`validator`, `required`, `maxLength` and the rest), as in grid cell editing. No new event: a listener that vetoes would duplicate what the field already does.
- **The list's navigation pauses during an edit.** The navigator subscribed to a list turns the arrow keys, Home and End into item moves, and Enter into a click on the active item; it only skips Enter for links and buttons. The plugin unsubscribes it for the edit and subscribes it again after. Changing the navigator itself would change every navigable component, and a picker's field relies on its Enter reaching the list.

## Test Evidence

Released (`dev`): F2 on `b.txt` selects it, and nothing else happens.

<img src="https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/c7cb01970ae337f4d3a31909193aaf87f3d798a5/review-evidence/21476/rename-released-list.png?raw=true" width="280" alt="dev: F2 on an item opens nothing">

Changed: F2 on `b.txt`, then typing; an emptied name with `editor: {required: true}`, after Enter; a double-click on a tree folder, then typing; the folder after Enter. A list without the plugin is unchanged by this PR and renders as released.

<img src="https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/26f644faa9a63353b1e5d20e82307440d791936d/review-evidence/21476/rename-list-editing.png?raw=true" width="280" alt="a list item in edit"> <img src="https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/26f644faa9a63353b1e5d20e82307440d791936d/review-evidence/21476/rename-list-veto.png?raw=true" width="280" alt="an empty name is refused, the edit stays open"> <img src="https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/26f644faa9a63353b1e5d20e82307440d791936d/review-evidence/21476/rename-tree-editing.png?raw=true" width="280" alt="a tree folder in edit, beside its icon"> <img src="https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/26f644faa9a63353b1e5d20e82307440d791936d/review-evidence/21476/rename-tree-renamed.png?raw=true" width="280" alt="the folder renamed">

Mutations, each reverted: without the navigator pause, the Escape arm fails (ArrowDown takes focus from the field); without the validation check, the veto arm fails. A throwaway probe spec took the frames; it is not committed.
